column2: Given these definitions: (1) Grace is a free giving whose gift is a maker's standing turned toward his own work. (2) A giving is free when it is not owed to the one who receives it, not compelled from the giver, and not made to secure a return. (3) A standing turned toward one's own work can be given to one by another, at least in part, as being faced and named by another can help one come to face. Then grace is the free giving of a standing turned toward one's own work, and such a giving can occur.
